versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- Changed default model from u1-insuremed to u2-med in parameter说明 section
- Updated skill name to health-exam-recheck-reminder in metadata
- No functional changes to core logic or outputs

- Initial release of health-exam-recheck-reminder skill.
- Extracts all items from health check reports that require re-examination, with urgency grading (2 weeks/1-3 months/3-6 months/6-12 months).
- Provides detailed JSON structured output including recheck items, department, venue, preparation, and purpose.
- Generates user-friendly recheck reminders tailored for examinees.
- Fully implements data minimization, de-identification, and no local persistence for privacy compliance.
- CLI supports both txt and json inputs; includes configuration options for API use.
